## Summary

Describe the change, its motivation, and its security or coverage impact.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated regression tests, including a safe negative case where applicable
- [ ] Ran `npm test`
- [ ] Ran `npm run verify:release`
- [ ] Ran `npm run benchmark` when scanner behavior or performance changed
- [ ] Ran a repository self-scan and reviewed coverage warnings
- [ ] Updated English documentation first and synchronized Chinese documentation when needed
- [ ] Confirmed no secrets, generated packages, unredacted reports, or private samples are included
- [ ] Confirmed the change never executes or installs scanned code

## Evidence

Include concise test output, benchmark deltas, or sanitized before/after findings.
